title: Idolophu Eyayikholelwa Kwixesha
intro: Kwiingxelo zenceba kaThixo, kukho uluntu oluye lwatshintsha yaba ngumzuzu wokuqonda izinto ngokubanzi. Uza kutyhila ibali labo—ibali lesilumkiso, inguquko, kunye nokuphumla okubenza bahluke kwisiphelo sezinye iintlanga.
clues: Sasingabantu ababethunywe isithunywa kubo, saza sayeka ubizo lwakhe ekuqaleni.
Xa iimpawu zesohlwayo esisondelayo zacaca, saqonda ukuba isilumkiso sakhe siyinyaniso.
Sabuyela eNkosini yethu ngenguquko enyanisekileyo, kwaye ukholo lwethu lwamkelwe.
Isohlwayo esasimiselwe phezu kwethu sasuswa ngenxa yokholo lwethu.
Ibali lethu licatshulwe njengento eyahlukileyo phakathi kweedolophu ezazikholelwa emva kokubona isohlwayo.
Sasingabantu bomprofeti owaginywa yinenga, kodwa sasindiswa ekutshatyalalisweni.
verse: And they believed, so We gave them enjoyment [of life] for a time. (37:148)
